note.zh-TW: 教材只有概念；公式（營運週期減平均付款天數）是網站補充定義。
note.en: The course gives only the idea; the formula (operating cycle less days payable) is a site supplement.

definition.zh-TW: 營運週期再扣掉平均付款天數，也就是公司自己的錢被壓在營運裡多少天。天數越短越輕鬆，甚至可能是負的。
definition.en: The operating cycle less days payable: how many days the company's own cash is tied up in operations. Shorter is easier, and it can even be negative.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
